references.text: The continuation of the same law regarding flogging, which limits the number of lashes to forty to preserve the dignity of the guilty.
Proverbs affirms the principle that punishment should be proportionate to the offense and carried out fairly.
Leviticus emphasizes fair judgment without favoring either the poor or the rich, supporting the principle of proportional punishment.
The principle of proportional punishment - an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth - which underlies assigning punishment according to the offense.
